test_title: PYST 27: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

As it is a rainy season, it __is raining cats and mice.__

options.text: it is raining tigers and lions
it is raining cats and dogs
it is raining dogs and wolves
it is raining birds and beats

solution:
The correct answer is: "**It is raining cats and dogs**."
